fix(launch): withhold git's whole repository-local list, config included

A hook's -c flags travel in GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, and config can relocate the worktree or alter a clone, so children lose it as git drops it when crossing repositories. The PR lookup's failure text now comes from the one launch-failure speller.

fix(launch): read the inherited environment live and let git config pass

The launcher keeps its owner's live environment and removes the
repository-scoped variables as each launch and the lifeline read it, so
a variable the owner sets later still reaches its children. Only git's
locating variables are withheld; its config variables name no
repository and pass through. The reason is stated once, beside the
list. Dead doctor lint config and the unread PR field record go.

fix(launch): strip repository-scoped variables once at scope build

The launcher's scope now holds its owner's environment less the
repository-scoped variables, so every child inherits that copy and an
overlay applies over it as given; the lifeline spawns with it too. The
renderer's boot hands on the same stripped environment. The list is
renamed for what it holds, its git part marked as a copy of git's, and
stale doctor citations and comments are corrected. The daemon case
moves into the existing PR-state fixture.

fix(launch): withhold repository-naming variables from the inherited base only

An overlay is a launch's explicit intent, so a variable it names now
reaches the child as given; only the ambient inherited environment loses
the names. The never-keyed overlay type and its type-level test go.

fix(launch): type the overlay against repository-naming variables and derive the forge part from the table

Each forge entry carries its CLI and the variable it reads as its
repository, and the withheld list derives its forge part from the
table, so a new forge cannot leave its variable out. An overlay naming
one of those variables no longer type-checks. The memory note says the
daemon's own environment still carries them.

fix(launch): withhold repository-local variables from inherited child environments

A daemon spawned from a git hook, a rebase --exec or a vcsh shell
inherits GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GH_REPO, which git and gh honour
ahead of the working directory. The launcher's one environment builder
now withholds git's repository-local set plus GH_REPO and GITLAB_REPO
from every child that inherits the owner's environment, after any
overlay. A session's own environment passes unchanged. The forge table
moves to a leaf module beside the list; plugin install no longer asks
git for the list at runtime.

fix(edit): edit chrome and placement state end with what they serve

Edit-mode controls (the insert libraries and their pages, the configure
list, the help pane) kept their open state after their placement was
gone, and a placement re-added under the same id reopened with it. An
author's own menu on a removed placement did the same.

Chrome is now a property of the key: every key edit mode mints sits in
one namespace no author spelling reaches, menu and accordion keys are
spelled injectively, and one classifier decides every read and write.
Every session write passes one router: chrome goes to the open edit,
beside its drafts and outside undo, or is dropped and logged with no
edit open, so it dies with the edit by any route, a restart included.

A placement's own state is released only by the click whose layout
write dropped it, comparing the config the click acted on with the
config its write loaded, through that click's journal so undo restores
it. A refresh releases nothing.
